# The protected corpus of an example station

These are the sentences this station has decided never to lose silently. The
check reads the table below and asserts each fragment is still where the row
says it is. Changing one stays allowed; changing it without moving the row
does not.

| fragment | home file | given | by |
|---|---|---|---|
| The light is lit before dusk, every day | notes/lantern.md | 1974-03-11 | the keeper before me |
| a fixture, not a self | README.md | 2026-09-09 | this repository |
